beats.event: Janitor with IQ 68; attends Alice Kinnian's literacy classes
Selected as the first human subject for IQ surgery
Surgery succeeds; his mind begins to sharpen
IQ triples; he outpaces his teachers and doctors
Realizes coworkers only befriended him to mock him
Sees Professor Nemur is exploiting him for career
Falls in love with Alice as an intellectual equal
Shames himself mocking a disabled dishwasher, then defends him
Confronts painful childhood memories of his mother
Algernon the mouse's intelligence begins to decline
Algernon dies; Charlie buries him in the yard
Identifies the Algernon-Gordon Effect in himself
His own mind begins to unravel
Returns to the old job but cannot bear the pity
Ends things with Alice; regressed beyond her reach
Enters state home; asks flowers be left on Algernon's grave
